backup.note: Archives contain private credentials. Restore only after reviewing compatibility with this exact firmware and package set.

Current config/runtime pair with CAKE download650Mbit/uploadunlimited split-gso service, BBRv1 default and matching ABI module files, tcp_ecn=2 retained after rejected AccECN request, three authorized authentication instances, wan3 automatic activation, three-member MWAN policies, the third-only hotplug patch, nine domestic DoH suffix policies, capacity checks and local health recovery. Keep together. Required runtime files match live bytes; archived core matches fixed installed core. No cold boot or device recovery was performed.

limits: The 921.67 Mbps result is a 6.99-second complete router download, not PC or stable 900 acceptance.
PC inner --resolve did not fix the Internet outer address; different hostname-resolution peers were observed.
PC latest sample proves same-window new owned UA3F outer flows and positive receive-byte growth on all three exits, but not per-curl mapping or an exact 4/4/4 split.
PC CAKE-on/off pairs did not hold the outer CDN fixed; do not infer a causal CAKE speed or CPU effect.
Current daily download CAKE is restored to 650 Mbit; estimated ideal IPv4 TCP application ceiling is roughly 612-617 Mbps.
The raw different-CDN triple 146.25 Mbps shows source/path sensitivity; it does not isolate a server or campus per-account quota.
Current RAM-to-PC WLAN samples include local HTTP-server cost and do not uniquely locate a Wi-Fi bottleneck.
No new account, network/auth/proxy restart, conntrack flush, firmware flash or persistent traffic-policy change was performed.
No three repeated 30-second PC windows above 900 Mbps were recorded; significant under-target PC results did not justify high-volume stability tests.
Campus www.gdpu.edu.cn remains a failing sample also reproduced under the original DNS policy; the complete DNS acceptance is not a pass.
No cold boot, hard power cycle, failover or existing-flow migration test was performed.
Simultaneous three-route reachability and ordinary multi-flow forwarding do not prove an independent third bandwidth allocation or single-flow aggregation.
Current CAKE restored to 650 Mbit ingress/unlimited egress; temporary bounded tests did not change persistent traffic policy.

tcp_memory_trial.decision: No demonstrated download improvement; restored original values.

backup_before_optimization.note: Archives contain private credentials. Restore only after reviewing compatibility with this exact firmware and package set.

optimize-summary.json.objective: Current PC position: speed, concurrency, signal and reliability; retain HE160.
optimize-summary.json.persistent_change: Authentication hotplug commits the address only after the recovery request succeeds; revalidates enabled state, lease and route before acting.

aql_trial.decision: Default restored; speed gain did not repeat.

downlink_sqm_trial.algorithm: Single aggregate WAN ingress IFB, HTB 520 Mbps plus fq_codel
downlink_sqm_trial.decision: Removed: lower successful-sample latency but lower throughput and higher CPU cost. CAKE and persistent sqm-scripts were not installed; upload shaping was not tested.

download_queue_trial.decision: No consistent gain; no production downloader changed.

optimize-summary.json.native_probe_limit: Each native load phase has only about 9-14 samples. No missing replies were recorded in these phases; this is not a long-term loss-rate estimate.
optimize-summary.json.api_probe_limit: Several IcmpSendEcho failures returned before their configured 900 ms timeout. API no-reply counts do not establish network packet loss; their cause remains unresolved. P95 uses successful replies only.

conclusion.text: 本文件中，16 条 curl 下载客户端的透明代理内层 ESTABLISHED 连接带有三组标记，分布为 6/5/5。三个 DHCP 出口地址可见于 4 条负载前已有的外层 TIME_WAIT 记录，且收包计数很小。全文件未记录同一固定下载源的 WAN 外层 ESTABLISHED 连接，因此不能据此确认三路实际承载本轮大下载。

method.outer_filter: TCP original dst=fixed_remote_ipv4,dport=80; original src is a current WAN address; reply src=fixed_remote_ipv4,sport=80 and reply dst is a current WAN address. Egress source address is inferred from reply dst after NAT, not original src.
method.inner_filter: load phase TCP ESTABLISHED with original destination fixed_remote_ipv4:80 and original source port equal to one of the 16 recorded curl local ports.
method.unique_key: original 4-tuple + reply 4-tuple + mark; repeated snapshots are not new connections.
method.time_base: Monotonic timestamps copied from baseline; no conversion to wall-clock attempted.
method.process_attribution: Conntrack contains no socket owner PID; UA3F process ownership cannot be verified from these rows alone.
method.counter_use: Time-wait counters are kernel per-connection counters, not application payload totals. They only establish these stored outer rows are small; no WAN payload total inferred.

next_adoption.accecn_version_boundary:
# AccECN：本机拒绝模式 3 的版本边界

当前设备的 `net.ipv4.tcp_ecn=3` 被内核以 `Invalid argument` 拒绝，随后读回仍为 `2`。本轮没有启用或协商 AccECN，无效持久文件已移除；`tcp_ecn_option=2`、`tcp_ecn_option_beacon=3`、`tcp_ecn_fallback=1` 保持原值。[实机操作记录](accecn-applied.json)、[最终运行验收](final-acceptance.json)。

原因已从“有符号但写入失败”收窄到明确的上游版本边界。官方稳定树 `v6.18.55` 的 `net/ipv4/sysctl_net_ipv4.c` 定义 `tcp_ecn_mode_max=2`，`tcp_ecn` 由 `proc_dou8vec_minmax` 处理，最小值为 0，最大值引用该变量。因此该版本的正常 sysctl 路径只接受 0～2，3～5 会在值范围检查时被拒绝。[固定同版源码](https://github.com/gregkh/linux/blob/v6.18.55/net/ipv4/sysctl_net_ipv4.c#L64)。

后续上游提交 `8ae3e8e6ceedfb3cf74ca18169c942e073586a39`，标题为 `tcp: accecn: enable AccECN`，明确将 `tcp_ecn_mode_max` 从 2 改为 5。这个 enable 改动没有包含在上述 `v6.18.55` 文件中。[上游 enable 提交](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/8ae3e8e6ceedfb3cf74ca18169c942e073586a39)。

同版参数文档和部分 AccECN 处理代码已经存在，设备也能看到 `tcp_accecn_process` 等符号；它们说明代码组件存在，不能代替公开 sysctl 是否开放、设备是否实际接受参数和连接是否协商成功。[同版参数文档](https://github.com/gregkh/linux/blob/v6.18.55/Documentation/networking/ip-sysctl.rst)、[设备符号与状态](current-runtime-socket.json)。所以早期依据文档与符号直接判定“当前可在线启用”的结论已经纠正于 [拥塞控制方案](congestion-install-plan.md)。

本机写入拒绝与同版源码上限一致，强烈支持该版本边界解释。这里没有反汇编实际安装内核或取得完整最终构建配置，因此不声称已经从二进制中读出了这个变量，也不把缺少某个假定的专用 Kconfig 选项当成根因。已验证事实仍是值 3 被拒绝、原值保持、无效持久文件不存在。

当前处理是保留原值，停止重复写入或尝试更高值。若以后确需主动 AccECN，应在包含完整实现、启用改动和相关修复的新内核构建中选择模式 3，重新匹配全部内核模块 ABI，使用 Redmi AX6000 RB06 的 stock 布局，并分别验证认证、Ninja、CAKE、握手和回退。当前只准备了机制与维护入口，没有为 AccECN 构建、刷入固件或重启路由器。不能只绕过 sysctl 上限就声称实现完整可用。

以后验收仍分开记录：值 3 的实际接受、新建连接 SYN 的请求、对端 SYN-ACK 与反馈的协商，以及拥塞收益。本轮第一层失败，后续层未执行。AccECN、普通 ECN、BBR 和 L4S 是不同条件，任一启用不能替代其他条件的证据。

PC CAKE-on/off pairs did not hold the outer CDN fixed; do not infer a causal CAKE speed or CPU effect.
Current daily download CAKE is restored to 650 Mbit; estimated ideal IPv4 TCP application ceiling is roughly 612-617 Mbps.
The raw different-CDN triple 146.25 Mbps shows source/path sensitivity; it does not isolate a server or campus per-account quota.
Current RAM-to-PC WLAN samples include local HTTP-server cost and do not uniquely locate a Wi-Fi bottleneck.
No new account, network/auth/proxy restart, conntrack flush, firmware flash or persistent traffic-policy change was performed.
No three repeated 30-second PC windows above 900 Mbps were recorded; significant under-target PC results did not justify high-volume stability tests.
